About EMTEX

One partner from part identification to connected data.

EMTEX Industrial Solutions brings together industrial marking, engraving, laser cutting and welding, special-purpose automation, vision, customized software and traceability. The objective is straightforward: give every component a permanent identity and connect that identity with production and quality data.

Solutions are selected around the actual component, material, mark requirement, cycle time, line condition and data architecture—then supported through trials, integration, training and after-sales service.

Application-led selection

Component trials and process review before recommendation.

Customized integration

Standalone machines, SPMs, robotics, vision and line connectivity.

Made for production

Permanent identification designed for industrial environments.

Lifecycle support

Installation, training, service and application assistance.

Product Portfolio

Industrial machines that leave a permanent impression.

Swipe to explore four core product families. EMTEX also supplies SPMs, robotic integration, traceability, vision inspection, laser cleaning and customized software.

Dot Pin Marking Machines

Permanent direct-part marking for metal components, including portable, bench-top and robotic integration.

Laser Marking Machines

Fiber, MOPA, UV and CO₂ marking for serial numbers, logos, QR and DataMatrix.

Laser Cutting Machines

Sheet and tube laser processing solutions.

Laser Welding Machines

Handheld and integrated laser welding systems.

01 · MARK — Permanent Identification

Dot-peen and laser marks for text, serials, logos, QR and DataMatrix.

02 · PROCESS — Laser Processing

Cutting, tube cutting, welding, engraving and cleaning solutions.

03 · AUTOMATE — SPM & Robotics

Fixtures, auto-clamping, conveyors, safety and production-line integration.

04 · CONNECT — Traceability & Vision

Code reading, validation, interlocks, genealogy and production records.

Industries We Serve

Built around real components and production conditions.

From deep marks on heavy fabricated parts to high-contrast codes on sensitive plastics, each application is assessed for permanence, readability, speed, integration and total operating value.

Automotive & EV

Engine and transmission parts, seating, suspension, castings, electrical components, batteries and assemblies.

Electrical & Electronics

Switchgear, cables, control modules, lamps, PCBs, connectors and precision housings.

Engineering & Fabrication

Machined parts, tools, fasteners, panels, sheet metal, heavy parts and fabricated structures.

Medical & Pharma

Medical devices, surgical instruments, UDI marking, packaging and traceable production.

Casting & Foundries

Permanent identification for rough, hot, coated or hard-to-handle components and batches.

Food, FMCG & Appliances

Packaging, branding, date and batch coding, utensils, home appliances and consumer products.
